query: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.slug, p.categoryId, c.name as catName, LEFT(p.description, 60) as desc_preview FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.categoryId = c.id WHERE c.slug NOT IN ('women') ORDER BY p.categoryId, p.id;
